# V1.8.9

Section: Source

**V1.8.9** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on September 15th, 2023.

## V1.8.9

- Rework - [#16776](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/16776) [#20088](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20088) Electric fluid valves now only consume electric when changing state
- Rework - [#18528](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/18528) Adjusted default workbench storage vehicle position for Meier starter base
- Fix - [#16140](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/16140) Linear track body hovering above connected tracks
- Fix - [#20283](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20283) Separator RPS node name
- Fix - [#20303](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20303) Pumpjack place/delete price discrepancy
- Fix - [#20329](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20329) Added drill grabber end to oil research group
- Fix - [#20439](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20439) Adjusted window diamond 1x4x5 placement surfaces
- Fix - [#20488](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20488) Fix back event for microprocessor save confirm screen
- Fix - Fluid jet now correctly updates the the world oil data

- Addon Lua:
- Feature - [#4786](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4786) Negative values for addDamage now repair the area
